# Paper 03: Visibility Systems and Exception Management

## Abstract

This note examines how shipment visibility systems affect exception handling.
Teams with automated exception triage detected material delays earlier and
escalated fewer false alarms to managers.

## Findings

- End-to-end visibility reduced time-to-detection by roughly one day.
- Automated exception triage lowered false-positive escalations.
- Teams still needed manual review for supplier communication and final action.

## Keywords

visibility, exception management, alerts, escalation
